Name: Professor Jasper Thomas (german translation)
Author: Mju
Description:
[center]Dear Community!

It's done! I've finally finished the translation for this great, lovable character. I've been working on it for days and at one point I thought I'd never finish it. But now it's done and hopefully it works. At least there is no smapi error message, I think that's a good sign ^^I really put a lot of effort into the translation to reflect the unique charm of our beloved professor. Of course, nobody is perfect and if you find any mistakes, please let me know and I will try to fix them as soon as possible. It may well be that the wrong pronoun is displayed in one or the other dialogue, but in general I have tried to neutralize the genders where possible so that nobody feels disadvantaged.A thousand thanks to 


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]lemurkat[/url], the creator of the modification! <3[/center]



[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][color=#ffff00][b]Installation:[/b][/color][/font]

1. Datei herunterladen

2. Ordner einfach im Modordner ENTPACKEN (wird oft vergessen und dann heisst es, das Mod funktioniert nicht XD)

Viel Spaß und ein tolles, erweitertes Spielerlebnis mit dieser tollen Mod!


[center]Bitte hinterlasst einen [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25097?tab=posts]Kommentar[/url]﻿, falls ihr noch  Fehler findet, ich spiele es selbst das erste mal und für einige Dialoge fehlte mir der Bezug/Kontext, daher die nachträglichen Korrekturen.[/center]
